en.title: Transform String
en.description:
The string contains only A, B, C, and D. You may repeatedly delete any adjacent A/B pair (in either order) or C/D pair (in either order). Output any result that cannot be reduced further.

This site adds a standard input/output protocol; this does not mean the original function-style problem had this protocol.
en.input: A single line with the string S; an empty string is given as an empty line.
en.output: Output an irreducible string; if the result is empty, output an empty line.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for the full approach, proof, and complexity.
hints: You only need to check whether the new character and the current end of the result form a deletable pair.
